entry.title: CompilerSutra Weekly — Edition 001
entry.summary:
CompilerSutra Weekly — Edition 001 Published 7 Nov 2026.
This week's compiler engineering developments: - Extract subvectors via vec_perm_const - Implement support for matrix splat cast - Add RISCVABI helper functions for single/doubleFP and purecap - [NVVM] Add nvvm.mulf Op - [NewPM] Use runCodeGenPipeline in SPIRVTranslate - [Fortran] Added support for functions to DWARFASTParserFortran - Clear NoPHIs after SIFixSGPRCopies under the new pass manager - [GlobalISel] Fold unmasked signed byte loads into D16 high loads
Coverage: 9 high-signal, 12 worth knowing.
Read the full issue: https://compilersutra.github.io/compilersutra-weekly/issues/2026/2026-11-07.html
